category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: Setup is safe to run again
history.description: Running setup a second time on a project that already has a ledger leaves the record alone: the branding, timeline and features stay as they are, and the settings file is only replaced when overwriting it is asked for explicitly.
history.dev_notes: cmdInit bails on an existing config.json unless --force; every other file is written only when absent.
